## Highlights
### Fixed
- Preserve supported destination restrictions in extension header rules and reject unsupported conditions - Prevent repeated extension permission dialogs, remember access choices, and explain permission consent when adding extensions - Request camera and notification access from compact site controls, remember choices per Space, and stop camera capture when access is revoked
---
